_NOTES.materialize_rationale: Reverting materialize→extract. 'materialize' IS a verb and is the established domain term in this module (line-state-evidence). All 15 functions are in the same api/ module family and 'materialize' accurately describes what they do — constructing concrete evidence records from raw JSONL events. Replacing the domain verb with 'extract' would lose meaning (they don't extract, they construct/materialize).
_NOTES.showStep_rationale: Reverted navigateToStep→showStep. The user marked this Y but 'show' IS a verb. showStep sets the active step and updates display — 'show' is accurate. 'navigate' implies URL routing which this doesn't do.
_NOTES.showToast_rationale: Same: show IS a verb, displayToast is not more descriptive.
_NOTES.boolean_prefix_rationale: Switched 'check' prefix on boolean-returning functions to is/has/does — these read more naturally as predicates: isGitAvailable(), hasAliasPathEndingWith(), doesEditBelongToFile().
_NOTES.al_prefix_rationale: All al* functions are ES module-private in jfred-alllines.js. Only renderAllLines() and bindBranchViewEvents() are exported. The al prefix was manual namespacing that is unnecessary in an ES module. Clean verb-first names without the module prefix are clearer.
_NOTES.parse_conflict: parseJsonlLines and parseJSONLLines (camelCase difference) both got mapped to parseJsonlToRecords. These need distinct names — see parseJsonlToRecords_CONFLICT note.
